findings.issue: New OpenCode descendants can exhaust the read budget before recorded owners.
findings.disposition: Prioritize recorded owners and explain the configured budget on a targeted retry.

findings.issue: Retained collections can make harness coverage incomplete while the ticket and batch totals remain complete.
findings.disposition: Derive ticket and aggregate counts from the same typed coverage.

findings.issue: An explicit summary-only request can skip a completed ledger.
findings.disposition: Handle the summary request independently on otherwise skipped completed ledgers.

findings.issue: An unsuccessful publication can count changed candidate facts as refreshed.
findings.disposition: Retain verified observations and count unpublished changes separately.

findings.issue: Fixed ledger staging can consume an unchanged summary with a valid colliding filename.
findings.disposition: Create an exclusive staging file under the owned workspace and preserve file mode.

findings.issue: A missing selected store can omit recorded-owner coverage.
findings.disposition: Inventory the selected accepted ledgers through read-only ownership and report retained owners or unavailable inventory.

findings.issue: Failed Git measurement can omit requested source coverage in a combined call.
findings.disposition: Report source work blocked by the Git failure while preserving the existing exit behavior.

findings.issue: Cancellation during a second source can discard observations from the completed first source.
findings.disposition: Report completed first-source observations as verified while preserving accepted files.

findings.issue: An invalid Git ref can hide a missing selected store and suppress its failure exit.
findings.disposition: Run selected-store preflight before Git measurement.

findings.issue: Candidate preparation failure can discard completed native source observations.
findings.disposition: Report verified reads and collection outcomes when the persisted comparison is unavailable.

findings.issue: The CLI tests can pass with an always-zero summary write count.
findings.disposition: Assert one summary write and zero ledger writes in the summary-only CLI repair case.

findings.issue: The checked-in CLI tests can pass if both uncommitted count fields are omitted.
findings.disposition: Retain the verified isolated CLI probe and mutation evidence. The tester owns the remaining nonblocking automation gap.
